description: This file defines the PinnedAppListViewModel class and its inner class PinnedAppListLiveData, which manage a list of user-pinned applications displayed on the home screen in an Android launcher app. It interacts with SharedPreferences to store and retrieve pinned app components, loading data asynchronously using AsyncTask.

classes.name: PinnedAppListViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel subclass that provides a list of pinned applications to the UI, maintaining an instance of PinnedAppListLiveData.

classes.name: PinnedAppListLiveData
classes.description: A LiveData subclass that loads and holds a list of pinned applications asynchronously, listening to SharedPreferences changes to update its data.

methods.name: PinnedAppListViewModel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewModel with the application context.

methods.name: getPinnedAppList
methods.description: Returns LiveData of the list of pinned applications.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Asynchronously loads pinned application data from SharedPreferences, querying the PackageManager for app details.
